name: Account collecting funds from many unrelated payers
description: A single account receives payments from numerous unrelated senders with no evident commercial or family link to the holder.
fp: Legitimate collection accounts such as clubs, landlords or small traders may show this pattern; check stated purpose.

links.ctx: A single recipient collects funds from many unrelated senders in different countries.

links.name: Unlicensed operator accounts receive many unrelated deposits
links.ctx: Personal or business accounts used as collection point for many senders without licence.

links.ctx: Single account collects from many businesses in a locality.
